text:
maria: FYI after the 08:00 rollout we are seeing a ~28% tokens/sec drop on the CTB pool and a bimodal latency tail. rollout paused for now.
deploy-bot: deployed commit 0f3a9c2 -> prod (eng-runtime), kernel-selector: auto-swap enabled, rollout 08:03
aj: grabbing traces. profiler shows memcopy spikes coincident with kernel swap and long queue_waits for small requests. flamegraph: https://perf.internal/trace/0f3a9c2
kevin: looks like the kernel-selection heuristic is triggering swaps for mid-size sequences. swap triggers a memcpy of KV shards which coincides with prefetch activity -> evictions and hit-rate cliff.
tiffany: KV hit-rate dropped 93% -> 76% around the window. seeing more GC on runtime threads. dashboard: https://grafana/ctb/kv-hitrate?from=08:00
maria: can we bisect the change? it seems correlated to the kernel-selector tweak merged yesterday (PR #4127).
jen: starting canary bisect, pinning kernel-selector to previous behavior on 3 pods.
aj: repro steps (micro): run mixed seq workload (8/128/512) with CTB enabled. snippet from logs:

```
[08:05:12.123] kernel_select: chosen_variant=A -> swap_to=B
[08:05:12.124] memcopy: 12.8ms (vmcopy=10.1ms)
[08:05:12.135] batcher: queue_wait=18.2ms
```
kevin: that memcopy matches our quantized-kernel memcpy path. if swap happens while KV prefetch is in-flight we lose warm pages and hit-rate collapses.
tiffany: note CTB pool has mixed instance types; scheduler now prefers variant B on Ampere16 (good for long seq) but hurts short-tail latency because it forces swaps.
sre-bot: perf-alert #CTB token_rate_drop triggered (08:06). affected hosts: ctbs-12-*, ctbs-14-*
maria: hold rollout until we confirm root cause. kevin, any quick config hotfix to avoid swaps for short seqs?
kevin: yes. kernel_selector.min_seq_for_swap was lowered to 64 in PR; set it back to 256 to avoid swaps for <256 tokens.
aj: canary test with min_seq_for_swap=256 on 3 pods: token/sec +10% vs prod, KV hit-rate ~92%. patch snippet:

```
--- a/runtime/kernel_selector.cpp
+++ b/runtime/kernel_selector.cpp
@@
- if (seq_len >= 64 && benefit_estimate > 0.2) swap_kernel();
+ if (seq_len >= 256 && benefit_estimate > 0.2) swap_kernel();
```
jen: bisect result: commit 0f3a9c2 (auto-swap heuristic) is the regression. reverting pre-0f3a9c2 removes the token/sec drop on canary.
sre-bot: rollout paused (manual) at 08:22 by @maria
tiffany: long-term fix ideas: make swaps non-blocking, offload memcopy to background worker, or keep warm standby variants pinned to avoid in-place memcpy.
maria: short-term plan: apply hotfix min_seq_for_swap=256, resume canary -> staged rollout. long-term: RFC for async swap + KV pinning.
aj: filed RW-#2391 with flamegraphs and traces, suggested mitigations, and added a CI test for mixed-seq CTB traffic.
kevin: i'll prototype async swap (background memcpy + atomic pointer flip), hope to get PR today.
jen: hotfix deployed to 3 canary pods. 15m health checks before staged rollout.
deploy-bot: canary patch deployed -> 3 pods (hotfix/min_seq_for_swap=256). staged rollout pending health checks.
maria: follow-ups: RW-#2391 (root cause + artifacts), RW-#2392 (RFC async kernel swap). consider postmortem if customer SLAs were impacted. :white_check_mark:
aj: monitoring KV hit-rate and token/sec; will post updates here.
tiffany: i'll keep the dashboard watch and alert if regressions reappear.
maria: nice work team. :thumbsup:
